newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinians detain a top intelligence official.
newsitem.headline: Palestinians detain a top intelligence official.

text.p: Palestinian police arrested the head of their military intelligence in Ramallah in the West Bank on suspicion of misuse of authority, PLO officials said on Wednesday.
They said Hussein Ilayan al-Sawadeh was arrested on Tuesday on orders from Palestinian President Yasser Arafat.
"Sawadeh was detained yesterday for interrogation," said Brigadier General Moussa Arafat, who heads military intelligence in the West Bank and Gaza, adding that he was still in detention.
Israel Radio reported on Tuesday that Sawadeh is suspected of involvement in the killing of Arabs who had sold land to Israelis in violation of a Palestinian Authority order.

Another PLO official, who did not want to be identified, said: "Arafat ordered the arrest of Sawadeh because he misused his position and maltreated Palestinians and for other reasons we will not mention."
Sawadeh was detained six months ago by Palestinian police on suspicion of torturing members of the Damascus-based Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine, but was released.
